answer_1.quote: The datasets that we have selected for evaluation are CNN/Daily Mail (CNN/DM), Extreme Summarization (XSum), and HumanEval. These tasks cover a broad spectrum of language processing capabilities, including text and code generation capabilities.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated summaries and code solutions.

answer_2.quote: We perform 1-shot evaluation for CNN/DM and XSum, and compare the ROUGE-2. We compare pass@1 and pass@10 for HumanEval.

answer_3.quote: For MT-bench, our base model is LLaMA-2-13B-Chat, and we use its program script to ask GPT-4 to give a score of 10 points for each round using their prompt templates and report the average score for a total of 160 answers for two turns of 80 questions.
